headline: 侠探杰克双榜霸屏，绿灯军团热力不减
headlineEn: Reacher dominates both charts, Green Lantern stays hot
summary: 今日零新片上映，本周仅8部新片。电影热搜由《怒之杀》《最后的曙光》领跑，剧集方面《绿灯军团》势头强劲；《侠探杰克》同时占据电影与电视热度榜，成为今日最大焦点。
summaryEn: No new movies today, only 8 this week. 'Fury of Kill' and 'The Last Dawn' lead film searches, while TV series 'Green Lantern' surges; 'Reacher' tops both movie and TV charts as the day's biggest highlight.

industryHighlights.text: 今日无新片上映，本周新片数量仅8部。
industryHighlights.en: No new movies today; only 8 new releases this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《侠探杰克》同时登上电影与电视热搜，跨媒介热度罕见。
industryHighlights.en: Reacher appears on both movie and TV trending lists, showing rare cross-medium heat.

industryHighlights.text: 《绿灯军团》在电视和电影双榜均进入周热，IP效应明显。
industryHighlights.en: Green Lantern made both weekly film and TV charts, highlighting strong IP appeal.

industryHighlights.text: 本周暂无重磅定档消息，市场静待下一波新片。
industryHighlights.en: No major release announcements this week; the market awaits the next wave.
